submission: C / MambaPlace x PandaSet bb0 (domain adaptation of R059-CORE-v1)
registered_before: any formal training step; probe results are appended to probe/probe_{coarse,fine}.json, not used to change this file

method.compat: release/patch_compat.diff applied on top of the commit (COMPAT_001/002/003)
method.verified_on_C: 35/35 OK after git apply of patch_compat.diff; no controlled file edited by C

domain_adaptation.mechanism: adapt/shim/sitecustomize.py MetaPathFinder alias, active only when MP_DOMAIN=pandaset
not_aliased: datapreparation.kitti360pose.imports (pickle classes; must stay the frozen module)
domain_adaptation.colors: unchanged upstream 8-colour palette; all release colours verified inside it

deviations.what: frozen literal imports resolved by a MetaPathFinder instead of editing training/evaluation files
deviations.why: editing them breaks meta/CODE_SHA256.txt (35 controlled files)

deviations.what: derived PointNet checkpoint assets/pointnet_pandaset_c16_8.pth: class_classifier 22->16 re-initialised, other 62 tensors bit-identical
deviations.why: models/object_encoder.py load_state_dict is strict and the frozen KITTI checkpoint has a 22-class head; PandaSet vocabulary is 15 real classes + the pad slot = 16
deviations.evidence_unused: class_pred is produced at models/pointcloud/pointnet2.py:95 and never consumed (object_encoder.py:92 uses .features2 only)
deviations.revisitable: yes, if E's S3DIS bb0 shows cross-domain PointNet needs retraining

deviations.what: class table gains the synthetic 'pad' slot required by Object3d.create_padding(); vocabulary 15 -> 16 slots, pad placed last exactly like upstream KITTI
deviations.why: frozen dataloading/pandasatpose/poses.py:155 does CLASS_TO_INDEX[obj.label] and the frozen fine datasets pad every cell to pad_size=16 objects; without a pad entry the code raises KeyError: 'pad'
deviations.found_by: fine 5-step probe (coarse probe passed because coarse datasets do not pad)
deviations.affects_math: only the width of the unused PointNet class head; real class indices 0..14 unchanged

domain_adaptation.pad_slot: CLASS_TO_INDEX['pad']=PAD_INDEX=15 (Object3d.create_padding label 'pad'; frozen fine datasets pad cells to pad_size=16). Upstream KITTI has the same slot at index 21 of 22.

text_backbone.note: local directory path substitution only; weights unchanged

commands.coarse_args: epochs 20, batch 64, coarse_embed_dim 256, lr 5e-4, step scheduler (7, 0.4), temperature 0.1, contrastive, shuffle, no_pc_augment, fixed_embedding
commands.fine_args: epochs 35, batch 32, fine_embed_dim 128, lr 3e-4, regressor_cell all, pmc_prob 0.5, shuffle, no_pc_augment, fixed_embedding

selection.coarse: VAL best-cell R@5 = val_acc[max(args.top_k)], strict improvement, earliest epoch
selection.fine: min mean VAL pose offset (calc_pose_error2 in unit-cell coords), strict improvement, earliest epoch
selection.test: not constructed during training (MP_NO_TEST=1); a single evaluation per registered chain after freeze

coarse.decode: official_matches_manual=true on the VAL pose farthest from its cell centre (25.498 m), discriminating=true

fine.decode: label_vs_pose.pose max abs 2.8e-08; world decode max abs 8.5e-07 m

probes.env: ENV_OK 13/13 (env/env_report_c.json); PyG FixedPoints(256) applied to the release's 100 points/object yields 256 rows of which 91-94 are distinct (upsampling with replacement, upstream behaviour, documented domain limitation)
probes.note: probe results are appended here and in probe/*.json; they were NOT used to alter any hyperparameter

pmc_measurement.interpretation: PMC is a sparse, per-scene augmentation on PandaSet: ~6.5% expected relocation, not the ~50% the recipe implies. Data-layout fact, not an implementation defect; pmc_prob/threshold left at the frozen recipe values.
pmc_measurement.note: an earlier bounded sample (8 poses/scene) gave 17.25% / 8.6%; the exhaustive run supersedes it

downstream_chain: own TRAIN/VAL coarse retrieval Top25 + own fine
3 SCAR heads seed 0/1/2, main head fixed to 0, head selection by the existing main-table contract
original ordering / strong-control / SCAR pairing in the same pool with the same fine offsets
independent verification (candidate uniqueness, coverage, per-query recomputation)
out_of_scope: extra backbone seeds (bb1/bb2) without explicit dispatch

clearance_basis.basis: explicit batch dispatch of MambaPlace x PandaSet bb0 to C; E's R059_PROTOCOL.json scope.excluded contains 'PandaSet (C)'; A's PandaSet task is Des4Pos x PandaSet, not MambaPlace
clearance_basis.written_by: C executor on the recorded dispatch, not a human scheduler signature
